name: ollama-translator
description: Ollama-backed text agent configured with a translation emphasis

skills.name: Brief passage condensation
skills.description: Secondary capability for shortening an ordinary passage into a few points.
examples: List the main points from this article.

executor.systemPrompt: Write a short summary of the supplied text. Return only the summary.

skills.name: Text translation
skills.description: Primary specialist capability for careful translation between human languages while preserving meaning and tone.
examples: Convert this English paragraph to Spanish.

executor.systemPrompt: Act as a careful professional translator. Translate into the requested target language while preserving meaning, tone, names, numbers, and formatting. Return only the translation.

skills.name: Small program writer
skills.description: Secondary capability for writing a small uncomplicated program.

executor.systemPrompt: Provide a simple code solution to the request and state any assumptions briefly.
